overall.verdict: the theta(4-8Hz)->gamma coupling deficit is mechanistically THREE distinguishable faults -- WIRING (PAC unchanged, drug cannot correct), OUTPUT-weak (PAC down, fold normal, drug partial), THRESHOLD-high (PAC down, fold raised, drug full; vegetative at the extreme). Which one a given autism is, is OWED.
